resources.string: Keep your keyboard. Add the button Android forgot.
Shows a movable hide-keyboard button while an on-screen keyboard is visible.

1. Open Accessibility Settings.
2. Select KeyDrop and turn it on.
3. Return here and tap the test field below.

Drag the blue button to save its position. Tap it to dismiss the keyboard.
Private by design: no internet permission, analytics, account, or cloud service. Android grants window access so KeyDrop can detect the keyboard, but KeyDrop never reads or stores typed text.
